column1: # Savarino 30.8 deg
# Two results here.
# 1. CROSS-BACKEND AGREEMENT. MUMPS (10 CPU ranks) and STRUMPACK (1 rank
#    A6000) give gain = 215.626 to every printed digit
#    factorisations
#    (MUMPS native transpose vs the dual-factor heal). First exercise of the heal on
#    the resolvent path.
# 2. THE GPU ENGAGES AT 450k DOF. Controlled A/B
#    everything else matched -- same unknowns
#    factor memory 10
#    14.1 s. Factor time 22.28 s (GPU) vs 389.49 s (GPU off) = 17.5x. The identical
#    reordering times rule out CPU contention as the explanation.
#    NOTE: nvidia-smi shows ~0% because the GPU window is 22 s inside a 558 s run;
#    sampling every few seconds mostly lands in reordering and the SVD solves. This
#    build's STRUMPACK prints no device line. Neither is evidence of GPU non-use --
#    the A/B factor time is.
# 3. THE GPU IS NOT THE BOTTLENECK FOR THIS CASE. Of job 611's 558 s: ~15 s mesh and
#    assembly
#    ~425 s (76%) in the randomized SVD's repeated solves. STRUMPACK's FGMRES-
#    preconditioned solve is slower per apply than a MUMPS triangular solve
#    still wins END TO END here (406.6 s vs 558.1 s) despite losing the factorisation
#    17.5x. Speeding up this map means attacking the solve phase
